title: sideritis altiatlantica
intro: Sideritis altiatlantica, commonly known as Atlantic mountain tea, is a plant species in the genus Sideritis, which is a type of flowering plant. It is native to the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sideritis altiatlantica include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its use in treating various conditions such as bronchitis and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
